scope: N3b: DESIGN-WORKLOG code terminal behaviour only; no visual redesign. Awwwards homepage checked live (HTTP 200; title Awwwards - Website Awards - Best Web Design Trends).
designDecisions: DESIGN-WORKLOG 3.1: Only real, applied changes. The pane is filled from the result of the step; a rejected/failed edit never shows a diff.
DESIGN-WORKLOG 3.1: Stays visible for the whole session. The pane keeps the latest code change while later build/test/commit steps run; its header identifies the originating step and time.
DESIGN-WORKLOG 5.5 and N3b: shared DiffPlex builder, declaration context, redaction and explicit size limits; CodeChangeId replaces repeated previews. P-11 defers before/after PNG evidence to N5.
